definitions.explanation: The largest or central island of an island group, as opposed to its outlying islands; most often heard of Okinawa.

examples.japanese: {本島|ほんとう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}った→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: We crossed over by boat from the main island.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧{本島|ほんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The main island of Okinawa is bigger than I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧{本島|ほんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{北部|ほくぶ}→北部：33617_hokubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧で、{那覇|なは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{南部|なんぶ}→南部：31707_nanbu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まったく⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧だ。
examples.english: The north of Okinawa's main island is rich in nature and feels completely different from the south, where Naha is.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧{本島|ほんとう}: the main island of Okinawa
- {本島|ほんとう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{離島|りとう}→離島：14597_ritou⟧: the main island and the outlying islands

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧ (true, really) has exactly the same reading; context always tells them apart.
- The main island of Japan, Honshu, is ⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧, not {本島|ほんとう}.
